prior_summary: Peg-frame Cartesian targets make approach, grasp alignment, and carried lift equivariant to the freshly observed peg pose.
applicable_conditions: Prefer after observable lid release and clearance, especially when peg_pose is displaced beyond the narrow demonstrated in-box range. The peg must remain observed and the resulting approach must be reachable without box-wall interference.
termination_guidance: Continue through the shared lift. Exit to reorient_and_stage_peg only when fingers are closed, peg height is above the wall with margin, and two causal frames show approximately stable peg-to-TCP pose while both move.
limitations: Early lid release is not the constructed invariant. Peg framing does not remove arm reachability, box/lid clearance, contact, or grasp dependencies. Training has no failed-grasp, drop, or regrasp recovery examples.
